title: Engineered and non-neural systems can be conscious

statements.text: Engineered systems, synthetic constructs and non-neural systems can have some degree of consciousness, given the right physical or causal organization.

sources.quote: systems that operate in morphogenetic, transcriptional, and other spaces should also have some (if very minimal) degree of consciousness

we advance a scale-free characterization of consciousness and cognition that regards basal systems, including synthetic constructs, as not only informative about the structure and function of experience in more complex systems
The theory entails that consciousness is a fundamental quantity, that it is graded, that it is present in infants and animals, and that it should be possible to build conscious artifacts.
